chapter: Kline 1980: early years and founding of the Goldkette orchestra
title: Joining Paul Specht in 1922
summary: He joined Specht's band around 1922 for about three years, playing drums and vibes and some piano; he remembers Specht as a big tall man and the band as successful.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Okay. So you played with this group and then you joined Paul Specht in 1922 I believe.
Tell me about Paul Specht What do you remember about him?
Well Paul Specht was a...let me see what was he. He was a free lance. And we just moved in on him. Because I knew him.
Darling, didn't you join him. You joined Paul Specht's band.
Right. And you were with him for about three years. Remember?
You played drums and vibes then or not?
What kind of music did they play?
Sounds popular. Okay. Did you play piano with him too?
But you didn't record piano with him?
You didn't record piano with him?
He had a...Do you remember anything about Paul Specht?
What kind of person, what kind of leader was he?
He was a big, tall guy.
Did he play any instruments though?
Well he played, let me see—I forget what he played.
What kind of a band? Was it a band that worked well together?
Why did you - you stayed with him about three years and then you left. Do you remember why?
